summary: <cite index="1-15,6-1">Tuesday's hot CPI report and hawkish Fed officials sent Treasury yields sharply higher and triggered a 0.38% decline in the S&P 500, with markets now pricing a 90% chance of a December rate hike</cite>. <cite index="3-10,4-6">Wednesday brought a sharp reversal as CoreWeave reported third-quarter revenue of $3.66 billion, beating estimates and raising full-year guidance to $13.0-$13.3 billion, sparking a broad rally in AI and semiconductor stocks</cite>. <cite index="3-6,7-4">The S&P 500 rose 0.9% and the Nasdaq Composite rallied 1.8% as chipmakers like Broadcom and Micron surged more than 5%</cite>. <cite index="26-4">Crypto markets faced over $723 million in liquidations following the inflation data, with nearly 79% from longs</cite>, though <cite index="27-3,27-4">Bitcoin recovered above $74,500 and Ethereum rose 3.6% to $2,094 on Wednesday as Deutsche Bank launched its institutional crypto custody service</cite>. The bond market remained closed for Veterans Day, leaving equities to digest inflation concerns without the usual fixed-income anchor.

signals.title: Hot CPI triggers Fed rate hike repricing to 90% odds
signals.desc: October CPI came in above consensus at 0.4%, prompting hawkish Fed commentary and pushing December rate-hike probability to 90%, pressuring risk assets.

signals.title: CoreWeave beats on revenue, raises guidance amid AI demand resilience
signals.desc: CoreWeave's Q3 revenue of $3.66B and raised full-year guidance to $13.0-13.3B fueled a 10.7% stock surge and lifted chip sector, signaling robust AI infrastructure spending.

signals.title: Anthropic IPO oversubscribed, targets $1.4T valuation
signals.desc: Anthropic's blockbuster IPO attracted orders several times available shares at a $1.4 trillion valuation target, reinforcing AI equity momentum and boosting sector sentiment.

signals.title: Crypto liquidations hit $723M as leveraged longs unwind
signals.desc: Hot CPI data triggered $723 million in crypto liquidations with 79% from longs, reflecting overleveraged positioning and fragile market structure in digital assets.

signals.title: Deutsche Bank launches crypto custody, Bitcoin reclaims $74K
signals.desc: Deutsche Bank's institutional custody launch for Bitcoin and Ethereum helped crypto recover from Tuesday's selloff, with BTC rebounding above $74,500 and ETH up 3.6%.

verdict: Markets face tug-of-war between hawkish Fed repricing and resilient AI earnings, with Wednesday's tech rally suggesting demand fundamentals may outweigh rate headwinds near-term.
